# Code Anchors: Item Category

- `src/data/model.ts` — the item's category, the six zone kinds, the zone an item sits in at a store, and the walking order
- `src/pages/ItemPage.tsx` — the category choice, with "No category"
- `src/pages/InStorePage.tsx` — orders the list by walking order and marks the next item's zone
- `firestore.rules` — the item rules that accept the six categories and freeze old placements
- `src/pages/ListPage.tsx` — sets or clears the category by a drop on the drop tray
- `src/services/firestoreData.ts` — the category-only item update
- `src/data/categoryGroups.ts` — names a custom category and treats an unknown stored value as no category (#121)
- `src/services/types.ts` — the category value is a free string, not only a zone kind (#121)
- `rules-tests/customCategoryItems.rules.test.ts` — tests that an item accepts a custom category only when it exists in the household (#121)
